disposition: All three private dataflow variants rejected: every pooled operator and every measured pair regressed against frozen Pair.

scope.operation: C32 expansion only: FLAGS24 K32 N128 Nmatrix128 P0 B1 E4 inputs/output, corrected mixed3 SiLU

source.publication: Two ordered K16 native RTE accumulator half publications; unchanged corrected mixed3 SiLU (three native half publications, two software stages), phase-mask prefix and frozen Pair software E4 compatibility publisher.

design.delta: Opaque accumulator constructor from host-validated raw positive-zero push bits replaces shared seed load; operand load retained.
Raw global uint8-to-E4 bitcast uses measured wave32 A-component map row=lane&15, column=(lane>>4)*8+i; shared zero seed retained.
Both independent seed and direct operand changes.

source.guards: Known device/driver, FP8 M16, full wave32, numeric float controls, VOTE/ARITH, component length8, stride/allocation bounds. Host checks reserved push bits exactly raw +0 before both diagnostic and persistent recording; no in-shader seed guard that could allow compiler zero folding.

cpu.sourceProofScope: CPU structure/addressing/Boolean/helper/float-control checks are separate from GPU arithmetic qualification.

boundedValidation.logCaveat: No stored contemporaneous logs exist for the two earlier bounded commands or driver-info command. Hash-bound manifests/source/EXE/module pins and root-observed exit0 are the recorded evidence; no log is fabricated.
boundedValidation.driverReportBinding: Six report names/module pins follow frozen source/EXE branch and bounded report device/driver identities; no separate driver-info identity JSON was emitted. Root completion log is bound only if supplied.

actualValidation.activatedF16Trace: Separate Pair F40 diagnostic; agreement does not expose original F24 pre-E4 half bits.
actualValidation.canonicalTimingOutput: Timing pre/post packed E4 outputs must match hashes derived from full strict actual allocations.

limitations: Known device/driver, inherited fixture corpus and fixed generated-model inputs only; component map is observed-driver compatibility, not a portable fragment contract.
No complete candidate graph, evolved histories, game sequence, HDR game validation or game FPS measurement.
B/C,C/B,B/C ordering is unbalanced; all samples and all21 pairs per variant retained. No cause assigned to observed variation.
Per-route GPU spans include compute barriers and exclude uploads, readback, CPU submission/wait and bridge. Isolated sums are estimates, not network latency.
Timing reports record layers disabled; bounded/actual manifests omit enabled-layer status.
Installed instrumented pipelines and offline RGA resources are separate observations. Static instructions do not establish dynamic delivery, occupancy or regression cause.
Earlier bounded/driver runs have no stored contemporaneous root logs; later actual/timing logs are retained and hash-bound.

review.scope: Metadata-only finalization after independent public source/provenance/resources/scalar timing/privacy review. Metrics, timing copies and documentation unchanged.
